method: Release/O3, 20000 initial enemies, combat, 1280x720, 240 measured frames after 30 warmups. Three alternating-order pairs. Behavior profiling off; six physics phase timers enabled in both variants. Diagnostic skips surface influence collection and binds zero influences, removing that visual effect. Not a production optimization.

diagnostic_changes.change: Skip render_influences_collect only when CBLUEPRINT_DIAG_NO_INFLUENCES is set. The fresh renderer then binds zero influences.
Enable game_physics_set_profiling when CBLUEPRINT_DIAG_PHYSICS is set, independently of behavior profiling.

cpu_sample.scenario: --bench-arena-scene-scale 20000 1200 0, combat; sample began about seven seconds after launch. This longer run reaches a different contact density than the 240-frame comparison. Sampling perturbs timing; use only for hotspot attribution.
cpu_sample.note: Inclusive nonrecursive samples for each named symbol. Symbols can overlap each other and must not be added. Inlined work can appear under callers. CPU sampling does not measure GPU execution time.
